HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE SWARANA KANTA SHARMA  ORDER % 02.09.2025 CRL.M.A. 26156/2025 (exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present petition, the petitioners are seeking quashing of the FIR bearing no.
0746/2016, registered at Police Station Nihal Vihar, for the commission of offences punishable under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC') and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom on the basis of settlement arrived at between both the parties vide Settlement Agreement dated 16.01.2018.
4.
All the petitioners are present before this court.
However, no one has appeared on behalf of the respondent no. 2 before this Court.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 03/09/2025 at 22:53:42 5.
Issue notice to respondent no. 2 through the Investigating Officer (IO) concerned, returnable on the next date of hearing.
